nico.descripcion: Male, about 19 years old, native Latin American Spanish speaker with a neutral Latin American accent (not Spain). Warm, friendly, slightly husky young voice in the baritone-tenor range. Casual and relaxed, like a university student talking to a close friend, with natural, expressive intonation and a hint of nervousness. Clear diction, moderate pace, no exaggeration.
nico.texto_referencia: Bueno, te cuento: mañana tengo examen de matemáticas y todavía no abrí ni un apunte. ¿Me ayudas? Te prometo que esta vez me concentro.

kori.descripcion: Bright, cheerful, youthful androgynous voice, high-pitched and playful, like an energetic cartoon sidekick. Native Latin American Spanish speaker with a neutral Latin American accent (not Spain). Upbeat and confident, smiling while speaking, clear articulation, slightly fast pace, natural and human-sounding.
kori.texto_referencia: ¡Hola! Soy Kori, tu asistente de tekorei. Hoy te traigo una herramienta gratis que te va a ahorrar horas de trabajo. ¿Listo? ¡Vamos!
